findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Not done - The guide tells the agent to start the full run right after the last product merge of a release or sign-off and to prepare notes while it runs, following that same run.
Case: normal use - a repo configured for local tests prepares a release or an unmarked prototype sign-off.
The immediate-start instruction applies only to CI mode. The generated workflow has no dispatch trigger or full-suite job in local mode (`src/forge/prcheck.py:250` and `:268`); local mode instead uses `forge test --full` (`src/forge/fullrun.py:14`). The guide still tells local clients to wait for the daily reminder. If a full run passed earlier that day, `forge next` does not issue that reminder after a product merge (`src/forge/fullrun.py:158`), so the agent can still discover missing proof only at the tag or sign-off gate. The local instructions need the same early-start, notes, and follow-through guidance.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a release or sign-off uses local test mode.
The named proof checks only that the CI dispatch wording occurs somewhere in the delivered guide. Its new-client fixture selects Actions (`tests/test_setup.py:228`), and the earlier-adopted fixture also selects CI (`tests/fixtures/adopted-v1.2.2/client/forge.toml:8`). The assertions pass with the local instructions still deferring the run to the daily reminder, so they do not protect the promised behavior in that supported mode. They also never check the watch command, so changing it to follow a different run would leave the proof green.
